name: meeting-notes-start
description: Start notes for this live call. Call it when the caller asks you to keep notes, track the topics, take minutes, or send a recap afterwards, even with no agenda. Voice-only. When the call ends, minutes are written and the recap goes to the principal. Do not also hand the recap off with async-offramp or delegate. Calling it twice is harmless.

outputs.notes_on: boolean (true once the call is marked for minutes and a recap)
